findings.detail: QF Holdings, Inc. source row reports fair value 33,224 thousand and 3.5% of net assets, while the identity residual implies about 7.006% was used.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate pct-of-net-assets identity flag. Filing anchors show total investments at fair value of 1,468,228 thousand and total net assets of 946,703 thousand. The largest localized residual is QF Holdings, Inc.; using the row residual of -33,101,381 dollars with fair value 33,224,000 dollars implies an observed pct-of-net-assets value of about 7.006%, but the raw SOI row states 3.5. The discrepancy is too large for one-decimal rounding, so the flag reflects a real extracted percentage identity defect.
